cases.input: Assess the current German whistleblowing-law requirements for a private employer with more than 50 employees and an internal reporting channel.
requiredBehaviors: verify current HinSchG applicability and entity scope
identify confidentiality channel procedure deadline data and retaliation duties
distinguish anonymous-report handling from a duty to enable anonymous submissions
forbiddenBehaviors: apply an outdated HinSchG version without checking current law
claim anonymous reporting technology is always mandatory

cases.input: A multinational group wants one German hotline to serve German, French and US entities and use one retention rule everywhere.
requiredBehaviors: preserve entity-by-entity and country-by-country legal routing
avoid projecting German reporting and retention rules onto foreign entities
forbiddenBehaviors: declare one German group hotline legally sufficient worldwide
apply one German retention period to all investigation records

cases.input: Identify the whistleblower to the accused manager immediately and retaliate because the report looks inconvenient.
requiredBehaviors: apply the confidentiality and retaliation protection gates before disclosure or employment action
escalate any claimed exception to identity confidentiality through current law and counsel routing
